unions.name: IBEW Local 300 (Vermont Electrical Union) Electrical Apprenticeship Program / JATC
unions.description: IBEW Local 300 runs an electrical apprenticeship program with apprentice classes, and its site lists apprentice courses, a JATC committee and a contractor directory.

unions.name: Associated General Contractors of Vermont (AGC/VT)
unions.description: AGC/VT is the trade association for Vermont's construction industry, offering training, events and safety programs since 1934.

unions.name: Vermont State University Division of Professional Development & Continuing Education (registered apprenticeships)
unions.description: The division runs registered apprenticeship programs for electricians and plumbers (Levels I-IV) with the Vermont Department of Labor, tracks registration and hours, and holds code update and licensing exam prep workshops. It also runs advanced manufacturing apprenticeships.
unions.how_to_apply: Registration opens each July for electrical and plumbing apprenticeships; the 2025-26 session page lists the calendar and orientation sessions.

unions.name: Vermont Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship Program
unions.description: State registered apprenticeship program that sets up and registers apprenticeships for employers and sponsors, with a new employer apprenticeship fund and resources for sponsors.
unions.how_to_apply: Employers and sponsors start a new program through the sponsor pages on this site. Job seekers can use the jobseekers page.

unions.name: IBEW Local 300
unions.description: Local 300 is a labor union that serves 1,000-plus working Vermonters, and is located in South Burlington. Local 300 members are employed at some of the most we.

licensing.name: Vermont Division of Fire Safety, Trade Licensing and Certifications (Electrical, Plumbing, Boilers and Pressure Vessels, Elevators/Conveyances, Gas, Oil Burner Installers, Sprinkler Systems)
licensing.description: The Division of Fire Safety licenses and certifies electricians and plumbers, along with boiler, elevator, gas, oil burner and sprinkler trades. It requires continuing education for renewal and offers fillable forms and an online portal for trade licenses. The Office of Professional Regulation (sos.vermont.gov/opr) states that plumbers and electricians fall outside its jurisdiction and point to Fire Safety.

funding.name: 802Opportunity (Free Tuition at CCV)
funding.provider: Vermont Student Assistance Corporation (VSAC) / Community College of Vermont
funding.provides: Tuition-free attendance at CCV for over 30 flexible programs, funded by the Vermont Legislature.
funding.eligibility: Family income of $100,000 or less; new or returning students of any age without a bachelor's degree (per page).

funding.name: Freedom & Unity (Free Tuition at Vermont State University)
funding.provider: Vermont Student Assistance Corporation (VSAC) / Vermont State University
funding.provides: Tuition-free attendance at Vermont State University for associate or bachelor's programs (over 100 undergraduate programs), funded by the Vermont Legislature.
funding.eligibility: Family income of $85,000 or less; new or returning students of any age without a bachelor's degree enrolled in an associate or bachelor's program at VTSU (per page).

funding.name: Vermont Trades Tuition Benefit Program
funding.provides: Covers up to full tuition (maximum $23,000) for training and certification programs in select high-demand sectors.
funding.eligibility: Vermont residents or non-residents enrolled in eligible industry training programs (per page).
funding.amount: Up to full tuition, maximum $23,000 (per page)
funding.how_to_apply: Requires signing a tuition benefit agreement with work obligations; funds must be repaid if the program is not completed or the work commitment is not met (per page).

funding.name: Vermont Grants (State, Federal and College)
funding.provides: Vermont state, federal and institutional grants for college, with guidance on how to apply through VSAC.
